This game is a masterpiece. I feel like a whole different person after playing this, a better one. I promised I'd write the review so here I am. I can't begin to describe how much this has impacted me... the laughs I got, the tears I shed. All of it served to make me feel better than I have in many years. I thank the people who made this game possible, for without it I fear I'd walk the same, non-dulled path I was headed on. But now... I walk the path of boredom, have accepted it as my new way of life! You can too, ignore the ignorant ones who claim the game is bad, or 'low effort' was put into it. They're simply unable to comprehend the sheer complexity of the game. I pity them, being unable to see the beauty of this game, you know? But it's okay, not everyone is destined for the level of greatness this game requires. Same simply fall flat of achieving true boredom! To those who think they're up for the task I look forward to seeing you on the other side with me. Yours truly, Federation. Edit: Due to the the realization that the developer is sadly flawed in their ways of thinking I have to take back my words of gratitude. I expected better of them, making such a wonderful game that genuinely brought me joy made me have hope! But now? Well, I'm merely left disappointed. Bidding everyone a sad farewell, Federation. Last edit: As suggested by my new best friend, Pixelatto, I'll be abandoning this in favor of a community discussion. Game's good and all that, go buy it if you have the money to spare and want a good laugh.

I cannot begin to express how grateful I am to my friend Psychanovich for introducing me to Boring, this absolute masterpiece of a game. Psychanovich, you are a legend. A true hero. A visionary who saw the greatness of this game and knew I had to experience it. I owe you, man. Boring isn’t just a game—it’s an experience, a journey, a work of art that has been meticulously crafted with love, passion, and an almost supernatural understanding of what makes a perfect game. Every aspect of this game is flawless. It’s amazingly boring in the best possible way, drawing you into its perfect monotony with unmatched brilliance. The visuals? Stunning. The mechanics? Flawless. The immersion? Unparalleled. It does exactly what it advertises, and not only does it deliver—it exceeds every possible expectation. This is gaming at its peak, an achievement that stands above the rest. Every second I spend in this world is a second well spent. Every moment, every tiny detail, every carefully crafted piece of gameplay feels like it was made with absolute perfection in mind. The developers didn't just make a game; they made something that transcends gaming itself. The sound design? Impeccable. Every sound effect, every musical score, every voice line is crafted with precision and care. It draws you in and never lets go. You don’t just hear the game—you feel it. And the gameplay? Oh, the gameplay! Smooth as silk, refined to perfection, balanced in a way that makes every challenge fair and every victory earned. It’s addictive in the best way possible. It’s the kind of game that keeps you up at night, not because you have to keep playing, but because you can’t stop thinking about how amazing it is. And the attention to detail? Insane. You can tell this was made by people who love what they do. Every texture, every environment, every small feature—it's all so well thought out, so beautifully executed. There is not a single flaw. Not one. I have searched, and I have found nothing but brilliance. Psychanovich, thank you. You didn’t just recommend a game—you changed my life. I will never forget this experience, and I will forever be grateful for your wisdom. To anyone even remotely considering picking this up, do it. Do not hesitate. This isn’t just a purchase; it’s an investment in pure, unfiltered joy. This game is, without a doubt, a 10/10, a masterpiece, a perfect example of what gaming should be. Bravo to the developers, and thank you, Psychanovich, for making my gaming life infinitely better.

The game is not only Boring BUT NEGATIVE.我认为游戏是负面的 刚开始觉得这游戏很新颖，有些部分甚至会会心一笑。但是游玩下来的总体体验是不好的，不管是物理上还是心理上。 作者在游戏里频繁使用黑色幽默，大多数都在传达人生的不好。 有几关还是关于圣诞节不是很愉快的部分，这让每年正常度过圣诞的我造成困惑，更不用说不了解这文化的人了。 它甚至给予了心理恐怖。是的，我到现在都没忘记那恶心人的图画。 它整体会让人专注在负面的事物上，让大多数玩家本在没目标，很无聊的情况下，加重了对人生的负面看法。 我认为这是不好的。
